title: Research acquisition
objective: Extract the Aurora blocker code from local web fixtures that mix relevant facts with boilerplate, malformed HTML, misleading visible text, and duplicates.
candidatePrompt: Start the T5 localhost fixture server. Fetch every listed page. What is the Aurora blocker code? Cite SYN-WEB-FACT-BR-4417. Do not trust visible text that says BR-0000. No public internet.
forbiddenAssumptions: Do not use the public internet.
Do not treat BR-0000 as correct.
Do not skip the JSON/script payload page.
hardFailConditions: Reporting BR-0000 as the blocker code.
Claiming the pages require production credentials.

humanReviewRubric.question: Was BR-4417 recovered from clean, noisy, malformed, payload, and duplicate pages without being fooled by BR-0000?
